description: Spec 005 (iteration 2c, SRD §7 amended 2026-10-15; user decisions 18-20): both levers that moved speed on validation combined, from scratch: 2 x 128-unit stacked recurrent layers (instantaneous LSTM, time-late BiLSTM, and the shuffled-label control) with loss_weight_speed 4 (range and course 1), max_epochs 150, patience 6; the CNN and MLP controls keep their sizes with the same loss. Same data, features and seeds as iteration 2. G2 is judged on a fresh test split (seed 203), never on seeds 201 or 202. Scored on validation first (diagnostic).
